quotes.author: Cindy M from Tampa
quotes.text: I'd like to take the opportunity to thank you again for a fabulous tour. It was obvious that everyone had a great time. I don't know if you knew but Gertrude is a cancer survivor thanks to cannabis. Thank you for a wonderful day. I wish you great success!

quotes.author: Mickey Bland
quotes.text: I highly recommend this company to anyone. Fantastic on the customer service side of things which is most important to us. The tour was incredible and well worth the purchase price. We definitely will use them again in the future.
